metadata.description: Andes: C#/.NET, Angular, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Azure DevOps standards for GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: andes-core
plugins.description: Shared AGENTS.md standards (via andes-init), PRD generation, technical writing with CHANGELOG ownership, the Microsoft Learn and Context7 MCP servers, and a desktop-notification hook.

plugins.name: andes-dotnet
plugins.description: C#/.NET standards as on-demand skills (C# 14, ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs, FluentValidation, Azure Functions, MCP servers, EF Core, xUnit v3 + NSubstitute) and a report-only C# reviewer.

plugins.name: andes-dotnet-wasm
plugins.description: Blazor WebAssembly (standalone, .NET 10) standards as an on-demand skill; builds on andes-dotnet.

plugins.name: andes-angular
plugins.description: Angular and NgRx Signal Store skills, a read-only Angular CLI MCP server, and a report-only Angular reviewer.

plugins.name: andes-github
plugins.description: GitHub Actions hardening, CI-efficiency, and runtime-upgrade skills with a report-only workflow reviewer.

plugins.name: andes-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform conventions as an on-demand skill and the Terraform MCP server limited to the public registry toolset.

plugins.name: andes-azure-devops
plugins.description: Azure DevOps backlog management: a scoped Azure DevOps MCP server (core, work, work-items domains), an approval-gated agent that creates, updates, and removes epics, features, and stories and always asks for assignee and iteration, and an init skill that records the project in AGENTS.md.
